Change the following sentence into the Active form.

The presentation has been given.
solution:

• Active voice sentences follow the structure: **Subject + Verb + Object**.
 
• Passive voice sentences follow the structure: **Object + Auxiliary Verb (be) + Past Participle + by + Subject**.
